SELECT COUNT(*) FROM novel n WHERE n.audit_status = 1 AND n.status IN (0, 1) AND n.title LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM novel_tag nt WHERE nt.novel_id = n.novel_id AND nt.tag_id = #{tagId})

SELECT n.novel_id, n.author_id, n.title, n.cover_url, n.description, n.status, n.audit_status, n.total_words, n.latest_chapter_id, c.chapter_no AS latest_chapter_no, c.title AS latest_chapter_title, c.publish_time AS latest_chapter_publish_time, u.nickname AS author_name, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url, n.created_at, n.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapter cc WHERE cc.novel_id = n.novel_id AND cc.status = 1 AND cc.audit_status = 1) AS chapter_count FROM novel n JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = n.author_id LEFT JOIN chapter c ON c.chapter_id = n.latest_chapter_id AND c.status = 1 AND c.audit_status = 1 WHERE n.novel_id = #{novelId} AND n.audit_status = 1 AND n.status IN (0, 1)

SELECT n.novel_id, n.author_id, n.title, n.cover_url, n.status, n.audit_status, n.total_words, n.latest_chapter_id, n.created_at, n.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapter c WHERE c.novel_id = n.novel_id AND c.status = 1) AS chapter_count FROM novel n WHERE n.author_id = #{authorId} ORDER BY n.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT novel_id, author_id, status, audit_status, total_words, latest_chapter_id, updated_at FROM novel WHERE novel_id = #{novelId}
